FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 599
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Chad Robertson
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/21/2025
House Bill 599 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency (ALEA) by an agency estimated $1 million to initially develop, and an estimated
$250,000 annually thereafter, to maintain, a publicly accessible domestic violence database on
the ALEA website and provide for an individual to petition ALEA for removal from the
database under certain conditions..
